name: Kashmiri wool stole
about: A hand-woven shawl from Kashmir, sold across India as a traditional craft. It is sold in New Delhi because the city has many government-run craft shops.
tip: Pure pashmina costs much more than standard wool, so check the label and ask whether it is 100% pashmina.

name: Masala spices
where: Khari Baoli spice market or Fabindia
about: Blended spice mixes used in North Indian tea and cooking. Khari Baoli is one of Asia's largest spice markets, located in Old Delhi.
tip: Check that the packet is sealed, and look for whole spices rather than only ground powder, which keeps its flavor longer.
